title: Trace a decision back to its evidence
description: Pair each research step with the question, evidence record, or decision artifact it produces. Follow the connections to see what supports what.
footer: Fictional sample: replace observations with your own evidence before making decisions.

plans.title: Review a product onboarding question
plans.summary: Investigate where first-time users stall, compare explanations, and record a testable decision.

steps.title: Define the decision and uncertainty
steps.description: Frame a question narrow enough to investigate. State what decision it will inform and what the study cannot establish.

artifact.title: Research question
artifact.code:
Decision: what to improve in first-project setup
Question: where do new users lose confidence before creating a project?
Study scope: the first session, from welcome screen to saved project
Evidence sought: observed hesitation, errors, and participant explanations
Not established: population-wide prevalence or long-term retention

steps.title: Record observations separately from interpretation
steps.description: Capture what happened and preserve a reference to the source. Keep your explanation distinct so later reviewers can challenge it.
steps.checkpoint: Each observation has a source reference and no unnecessary personal data.

artifact.title: Evidence record template
artifact.code:
Evidence ID: E-01
Source reference: [session note and timestamp]
Observation: [what was said or done]
Context: [task, screen, and relevant prior action]
Interpretation: [possible explanation, clearly labeled]
Alternative explanation: [what else could account for it]
Handling: anonymize identifying details
artifact.note: This is a template, not collected participant data.

steps.title: Compare explanations against the evidence
steps.description: Group related observations, including contradictions. Keep references to the evidence so a finding remains inspectable.

artifact.title: Finding worksheet
artifact.code:
Candidate finding: [one specific pattern]
Supporting evidence: [E-01, E-04, ...]
Contradicting evidence: [E-03, ...]
Possible explanation: [hypothesis]
Confidence and limits: [sample, context, and unresolved questions]
Decision relevance: [how this informs the original question]

steps.title: Record a reversible next step
steps.description: Choose a small change that addresses the supported finding. Write down the evidence and the observation that would make you reconsider.

artifact.title: Decision record
artifact.code:
Decision: [specific change to test]
Why now: [finding and evidence IDs]
Alternative considered: [other viable option]
Assumption: [what must hold for this change to help]
Success observation: [observable behavior, not a vague goal]
Reconsider if: [counterevidence]
Owner and review date: [assign before starting]

steps.title: Revisit the decision after testing
steps.description: Compare the new observations with the recorded assumption. Keep, revise, or reverse the change and preserve the reason.

artifact.title: Follow-up note
artifact.code:
Decision reviewed: [record ID]
New evidence: [source references]
Expected behavior: [from decision record]
Observed behavior: [what happened]
Conclusion: keep / revise / reverse
Reason: [evidence-based explanation]
Next question: [remaining uncertainty]
